meta.title: 管理是管人还是管事？不同层级答案不一样
meta.title_en: Manage People or Tasks? It Depends on Your Level

scenes.context: 讲者拆解「管人还是管事」的伪问题，指出管理是目标导向、以事为先。
sentences: 你事没做好，只是把人管好了，这个结果你拿到了吗？
If you only manage people but the work fails, do you get the results?
把事做好：get things done
在商业公司里，作为管理者，你一定是目标导向。
In a business, a manager is always results-driven.
目标导向：results-driven
组织是关于人的，但一定是建立在事情之上。
Organizations are about people, but they're built on the work.
建立在事情之上：built on the work
paraphrase: 管人管事之争是伪问题
The people-vs-tasks debate is a false dilemma.
scenes.speak: If you only manage people but the work fails, do you get the results? In a business, a manager is always results-driven. Organizations are about people, but they're built on the work.

scenes.title_en: Layers of objectives and how to measure them
scenes.context: 讲者讲不同层级管不同层次的「事」，并以乔布斯的量化方法为例。
sentences: 你写一个特别具体的O，还是写一个自己愿景的O？
Do you write a very concrete objective, or one tied to your vision?
愿景的O：a vision-level objective
比如说乔布斯说，我要为我的消费者提供最好的产品，这怎么量化？
Jobs said he wanted to deliver the best products — how do you quantify that?
量化：quantify
我推出的每一个产品，都应该比我之前的产品更好，销量要更好。
Every product I ship should be better than the last — better sales, better satisfaction.
用户满意度：user satisfaction
paraphrase: Each level manages a different kind of objective.
scenes.speak: Do you write a very concrete objective, or one tied to your vision? Jobs said he wanted to deliver the best products — how do you quantify that? Every product I ship should be better than the last — better sales, better satisfaction.

scenes.context: 讲者用船长招募水手的比喻讲人手策略，并强调中层要向上管理、上下打通。
sentences: 如果你有很多钱，就可以只招最优秀的人，不需要太多管理。
With deep pockets you hire only the best, and they need little managing.
只招最优秀的人：hire only the best
精英是要高回报的，要给足够的授权和关注。
Top talent demands high rewards — give them autonomy and attention.
授权和关注：autonomy and attention
作为中层管理者，你要向上管理，跟老板建立信息管道。
As a middle manager, manage up — build an information pipeline with your boss.
向上管理：manage up
paraphrase: Your people strategy follows your resources.
Middle managers are the information hub.
scenes.speak: With deep pockets you hire only the best, and they need little managing. Top talent demands high rewards — give them autonomy and attention. As a middle manager, manage up — build an information pipeline with your boss.

practice: The work and the goal come first.
Write a bigger objective so you can break it into KPIs.
Quantify your vision: every product better than the last.
Manage up and build an information pipeline.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Manage people or manage matters.
✓ 地道说法：Manage people or manage tasks.
✕ 直译腔：Write a big O so you can disassemble KPI.
✓ 地道说法：Write a bigger objective so you can break it into KPIs.
✕ 直译腔：The team is good and bad mixed.
✓ 地道说法：The team is a mixed bag.
✕ 直译腔：Middle managers should build a message pipe.
✓ 地道说法：Middle managers build an information pipeline.
shifts: 高层方向、中层目标、一线具体事
中层向上管理、上下打通
